task: modify the persistence layer to support future changes to the management of municipal reports
goal: understand the main data entities, their relationships, persisted information throughout the lifecycle of a report, and application dependencies on this persisted information
scope: users, reports, locations, categories, states, state changes, internal notes, and notifications
constraints: must understand relationships and dependencies before modifying the database
source_goal: I am a database engineer. I need to modify the persistence layer to support future changes to the management of municipal reports. Before modifying the database, I need to understand the main data entities stored by the system, the relationships among them, and which information must be persisted throughout the lifecycle of a report. In particular, I need to understand how users, reports, locations, categories, states, state changes, internal notes, and notifications are related, and which parts of the application depend on this persisted information.
